subject: Palisade security review and questionnaire — scheduling coordination
messages:
From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@palisade-sys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Archer <tom.archer@palisade-sys.com>, procurement@palisade-sys.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Security review request — Palisade Systems

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Palisade's security and procurement teams would like to schedule a formal security review and walkthrough of Redwood's hosted API and Dedicated deployment options. Attendees we expect from our side: myself (security lead), Tom Archer (platform engineer), and a procurement rep to ask contract/retention questions.

What we need from Redwood: 1) a 30–45 minute session to review network/data flow, encryption, audit logs, and SOC2 controls; 2) a point of contact from your security/compliance team; and 3) any pre-read (questionnaire/attestation) we can review ahead of the call.

We are targeting the week of Oct 11–15. Please propose a few windows (we are ET, UTC-4). Also confirm whether Redwood needs an NDA/DocuSign before sharing SOC2 artifacts.

Thanks —
Lena Brooks
Security Lead, Palisade Systems
Lena.Brooks@palisade-sys.com

Attachment: Palisade-Security-Questionnaire-v3.pdf (filled with high-level expectations)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@palisade-sys.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Palisade Systems

Lena — great to connect. Thanks for the details and the questionnaire — useful context.

Proposed slots (all ET / UTC-4):
- Tue Oct 12, 11:00–11:45 ET (15:00–15:45 UTC)
- Wed Oct 13, 14:00–14:30 ET (18:00–18:30 UTC)
- Thu Oct 14, 09:30–10:15 ET (13:30–14:15 UTC)

I have CC'd Hiro (our Solutions Engineer) and Kimberly (our Security & Compliance lead) so they can confirm coverage. Agenda proposal (30–45 min):
1) 5 min intros and scope
2) 15–25 min systems walkthrough (network, encryption, audit logs)
3) 5–10 min SOC2 / artifacts & next steps (DocuSign/NDA if required)

We can share a short pre-read and our standard security brief ahead of time (attached: redwood-sec-kickoff-brief.pdf). We typically do not require an NDA before sharing SOC2 Type II reports; we can provide redacted artifacts via a secure link or via DocuSign access if your procurement prefers that workflow.

Which slot works for your team? If you'd rather propose a specific time, we will accommodate.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@palisade-sys.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Palisade Systems

Hi all — Kim from Redwood security. Monica, thanks for looping me in.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can we make the session 45 minutes to allow a short Q&A after the walkthrough? That helps for procurement/retention specifics.
- Please confirm the full attendee list (names + role) so we can tailor the level of detail (network diagrams vs high-level controls).
- Preferred video platform? We can host via Zoom (we'll send a secure meeting link) or join a customer Webex/Teams if you have restrictions.

I'll review Palisade's questionnaire offline and send a brief mapping doc against Redwood controls before the call. If you want SOC2 artifacts before the meeting, let me know and we'll provide a secure read-only access link (DocuSign not required for read-only access, but we can do it on request).

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@palisade-sys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Archer <tom.archer@palisade-sys.com>, procurement@palisade-sys.com
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 10:14:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Palisade Systems

Hi Monica / Kim —

Thanks — we reviewed the slots internally. The team prefers Wed Oct 13, 15:00–15:45 ET (18:00–18:45 UTC). That gives Tom and our procurement rep enough time to join after other commitments.

Confirmed attendees from Palisade:
- Lena Brooks, Security Lead (lena.brooks@palisade-sys.com)
- Tom Archer, Platform Engineer (tom.archer@palisade-sys.com)
- Sara Lopez, Procurement (procurement@palisade-sys.com)

We prefer Redwood to host (Zoom). We also request that the meeting invite include a link to the pre-read and to any SOC2 access steps or NDAs if those are required after the call. Procurement would like to review your standard retention terms and a sample contract clause during the call.

We'll await the calendar invite.

— Lena
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
